description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related interfaces and macros for system information retrieval within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes declarations for system metrics such as memory, CPU load, uptime, and environment variables, as well as external service metadata and module information.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system metrics and environment management functions, implemented as a singleton.

classes.name: MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of system memory statistics, with JSON serialization capability.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force update.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Serializes the memory snapshot data into a JSON string.

methods.name: SwapTotal
methods.description: Returns total swap memory in bytes.

methods.name: SwapFree
methods.description: Returns free swap memory in bytes.

methods.name: SwapCached
methods.description: Returns cached swap memory in bytes.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns the current system tick count in microseconds.
